title: Perfect Announces Receipt of Preliminary Non-Binding “Going Private” Proposal
summary: Perfect Corp. (NYSE: PERF) (“Perfect” or the “Company”), a leading artificial intelligence (“AI”) company offering AI and augmented reality (“AR”) powered solutions to beauty, fashion, photo and video creative industries, today announced that its board of directors (the “Board”) has received a preliminary non-binding proposal letter, dated March 18, 2026 (the “Proposal”), from CyberLink International Technology Corp. (“CyberLink”) and Ms. Alice H. Chang, Chairwoman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Perfect, and her controlled entities (collectively, the “Consortium Members”) that proposes a “going-private” transaction for US$1.95 in cash per ordinary share (the “Transaction”). According to the Proposal, the Consortium Members will establish an acquisition vehicle to implement the Transaction.
